name: Finachub Checkout for M-Pesa
author: bnyamesa

sections.description:
Finachub Checkout for M-Pesa is a lightweight and powerful WooCommerce payment gateway plugin that allows your online store to accept M-Pesa payments seamlessly. With a focus on speed, security, and a modern user experience, this plugin is perfect for merchants looking to expand their payment options and tap into the fast-growing mobile payment market in Africa.

Key features include:
– M-Pesa Payment Integration: Easy setup for mobile payment processing with M-Pesa.
– Fast Payment Processing: Initiate M-Pesa STK Push transactions quickly, reducing checkout friction.
– Static Waiting Page: A responsive waiting page with a spinner to reassure customers while payments are processing.
– Manual Order Verification: Automatically update order status once the payment is confirmed.
– Minimal Admin Dashboard: Keep your backend uncluttered with a streamlined dashboard for plugin configuration.
– Responsive & Modern Design: Clean design and responsive layout optimized for mobile and desktop devices.

Upgrade to Finachub Checkout for M-Pesa Pro for enhanced features such as automatic order updates, callback handling, dashboard and analytics, CSV export, and priority customer support.

Thank you for choosing Finachub Checkout for M-Pesa!
sections.installation:
1. Prerequisites:
    • WooCommerce must be installed and activated.
    • Your website must operate over HTTPS.
  2. Upload Plugin Files:
    • Upload the entire finachub-checkout-for-m-pesa folder to your /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  3. Activate the Plugin:
    • Log into your WordPress admin area, navigate to Plugins, and activate “Finachub Checkout for M-Pesa”.
  4. Configure the Plugin:
    • Go to WooCommerce → Settings → Payments.
    • Enable the M-Pesa payment method.
    • Enter your M-Pesa API credentials (Consumer Key, Consumer Secret, Short Code, and Passkey).
    • Save your settings.
sections.faq:
Why should I use Finachub Checkout for M-Pesa?

It enables your WooCommerce store to accept mobile payments via M-Pesa, making it easier for customers to pay using their phones. This increases conversion rates and expands your market reach.

Is my transaction data secure?

Absolutely. The plugin uses secure API calls to Safaricom’s M-Pesa endpoints and includes robust logging for transaction tracking.

What happens if the payment is not confirmed automatically?

In the free version, you will see a static waiting page and receive an email confirmation. For automatic order status updates and advanced tracking, consider upgrading to the Pro version.

How do I upgrade to the Pro version?

Simply visit Upgrade to Pro at Finachub to learn more about the enhanced features and pricing options.
